# Data

* [Database schema overview (SQLite, V1)](schema.md) - One Flyway migration creates the users, sessions and todos tables in a single SQLite file, with table owners and one accepted cross-module foreign key.
* [sessions table](sessions.md) - The sessions table keeps one row per login, keyed by the SHA-256 hash of the cookie token, with an absolute expiry time and a cascading foreign key to users.
* [todos table](todos.md) - The todos table stores one row per to-do owned by one user, with a random public id, a trimmed title, a description stored as sent (NULL when blank), a required date-only due date, a priority, a done flag and UTC timestamps.
* [users table](users.md) - The users table holds one row per account, with the trimmed identifier in its original case, a lower-cased unique key and an Argon2id password hash, and no role column.
